def solve():
    n, mod = map(int, input().split())
    mid = n * (n - 1) // 2
    limit = n * (n - 1)
    dp = [[0] * (limit + 1) for _ in range(n + 1)]
    dp_next = [[0] * (limit + 1) for _ in range(n + 1)]
    dp[1][mid] = 1
    for i in range(2, n + 1):
        low_bound = mid - (i - 1) * (i - 2) // 2
        high_bound = mid + (i - 1) * (i - 2) // 2
        for x in range(low_bound, high_bound + 1):
            for delta in range(-i + 1, i):
                index = x + delta
                if 0 <= index <= limit:
                    dp[i][index] = (dp[i][index] + dp[i - 1][x] * (i - abs(delta))) % mod
        for x in range(low_bound, high_bound + 1):
            dp_next[i][x] = dp_next[i - 1][x] * i % mod
        for x in range(low_bound, high_bound + 1):
            for delta in range(1, i):
                index = x - delta
                if 0 <= index <= limit:
                    dp_next[i][index] = (dp_next[i][index] + dp[i - 1][x] * (i - delta)) % mod
    print(sum(dp_next[n][mid + 1:]) % mod)

    long long limit = (long long)n * (n - 1);
    vector<vector<long long>> dp(n + 1, vector<long long>(limit + 1, 0));
    vector<vector<long long>> dp_next(n + 1, vector<long long>(limit + 1, 0));
    dp[1][mid] = 1;
    for (int i = 2; i <= n; ++i) {
        long long low_bound = mid - (long long)(i - 1) * (i - 2) / 2;
        long long high_bound = mid + (long long)(i - 1) * (i - 2) / 2;
        for (long long x = low_bound; x <= high_bound; ++x) {
            for (int delta = -i + 1; delta < i; ++delta) {
                long long index = x + delta;
                if (0 <= index && index <= limit) {
                    dp[i][index] = (dp[i][index] + dp[i - 1][x] * (i - abs(delta))) % mod;
                }
            }
        }
        for (long long x = low_bound; x <= high_bound; ++x) {
            dp_next[i][x] = (dp_next[i - 1][x] * i) % mod;
        }
        for (long long x = low_bound; x <= high_bound; ++x) {
            for (int delta = 1; delta < i; ++delta) {
                long long index = x - delta;
                if (0 <= index && index <= limit) {
                    dp_next[i][index] = (dp_next[i][index] + dp[i - 1][x] * (i - delta)) % mod;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    long long result = 0;
    for (long long x = mid + 1; x <= limit; ++x) {
        result = (result + dp_next[n][x]) % mod;
    }
    cout << result << "\n";
